title: A postán
intro: You want to send a birthday card to your family in Romania. You take a number and wait for your turn.

a.speaker: Postás
a.textEn: Good afternoon! What would you like?

choices.text: Jó napot! Ezt a levelet szeretném feladni Romániába.
choices.textEn: Hello! I'd like to send this letter to Romania.
choices.textRo: Bună ziua! Aș dori să trimit scrisoarea asta în România.

choices.note: Direction "to" a country: Romániába (-ba/-be). Romániában means "in Romania".

a2.speaker: Postás
a2.textEn: Would you like to send it to Romania?
a2.textRo: Doriți să o trimiteți în România?

b.speaker: Postás
b.text: Elsőbbségi vagy normál? Az elsőbbségi gyorsabb.
b.textEn: Priority or standard? Priority is faster.
b.textRo: Prioritar sau normal? Prioritarul e mai rapid.

choices.textEn: Priority, please. When will it arrive?
Standard, please. I'm not in a hurry.
choices.textRo: Normal, vă rog. Nu mă grăbesc.

c.speaker: Postás
c.text: Pár napon belül. Rá kell írni a feladót is.
c.textEn: Within a few days. You also have to write the sender on it.
c.textRo: În câteva zile. Trebuie să scrieți și expeditorul.

choices.textEn: Sure. May I have a pen?
choices.textRo: Sigur. Pot să cer un pix?

d.speaker: Postás
d.text: Tessék. … Köszönöm. A bélyeg itt van rajta.
d.textEn: Here you are. … Thank you. The stamp is on it here.
d.textRo: Poftiți. … Mulțumesc. Timbrul e pus aici.

choices.textEn: Thank you very much! Have a nice day!
